results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested shadow change, the gravel-covered ground becomes nearly uniform fine sand, the twig and many stones disappear, and the post loses its knots and changes width and height; the central upright composition remains. Instruction: the long leftward shadow becomes a cleaner, dark diagonal shadow instead of disappearing as required by the supplied expectation, so the requested noon shadow outcome is absent. Knowledge: the explanation explicitly requires no shadow, but a long cast shadow remains. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: assessed alone, the upright wooden post has coherent edges and grain, the ground has continuous texture, and the attached directional shadow is structurally natural, with no noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: excluding the permitted viewpoint change, the black frame and botanical photograph remain recognizable, but the thin open frame construction becomes a thick solid-sided housing, the wire rear support disappears, and the white background becomes gray with a floor shadow. Instruction: the front is foreshortened into an oblique view, but a broad section of the photograph remains visible; the reference instead shows a narrow tilted side profile with the rear wire stand fully exposed. The attempted turn therefore has major orientation and support/occlusion errors. Quality: assessed alone, the rectangular frame, photograph and mat are coherent, its edges and perspective are orderly, and the neutral background and soft contact shadow are clean, with no noticeable artifacts.
